sections.heading: BETTER SOURCING. STRONGER COMMERCE.
sections.text: WHOLESALE PROCUREMENT • MULTICHANNEL RETAIL • SUPPLIER PARTNERSHIPS BETTER SOURCING. STRONGER COMMERCE. Locke Investments LLC is a Michigan-based wholesale procurement and multichannel retail company focused on sourcing consumer products through established manufacturers, authorized distributors and wholesale suppliers. We emphasize legitimate sourcing, documented inventory, responsible product representation and long-term supplier relationships. sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.text: LAST UPDATED — AUGUST 2026 Accessibility Locke Investments LLC is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for all visitors, including those with disabilities. We strive to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA standards. This site is built with semantic HTML, logical heading hierarchy, keyboard-navigable controls, visible focus states, descriptive link text and alternative text for meaningful images. We test regularly and address issues as they are identified. If you encounter any accessibility barriers while using this site, please contact us at admin@lockeinvestments.net so we can address the issue.
